phase_3.void_description: Unformed clay before any letter or seal
phase_3.both_description: Clay at the instant the name is half-written

steps.domain_action: Unformed clay lies ready
First letter of the name is traced
Second letter of the name is traced
Third letter of the name is traced
The name begins to refer to itself
Protective circle is closed around the clay
Clay is linked to the circle boundary
Name diagram splits vocal and geometric branches
Vocal branch spoken correctly
Geometric branch drawn incorrectly
Clay holds both living and inert potential
Seal with name reunites branches into life
Life force enters the limbs
Golem rises and obeys
Rite recorded on tablet
Command given to the golem
Name erased to deactivate
Deactivation composes reverse seals
Golem recognizes its return to clay
Final state permanently recorded
